name: Charter Communications (CHTR)
teaser: Deeply undervalued after the Cox and Liberty Broadband deals, but roughly $110B of net debt caps this at Hold until the buy zone near $105.
llms: Charter Communications provides cable broadband, video and mobile service in the US, now much bigger and more leveraged after closing the Cox and Liberty Broadband deals. At $112.91 the stock trades far below triangulated Base $234 (Bear $111, Bull $379), but leverage of roughly $110B net debt caps the required 55% margin of safety buy zone at about $105. Verdict: Hold at $112.91, watchlist for new money, maximum buy price about $105.
